scoring_justification: Result-level compare: the agent reports the final computed band gap and formation energy in JSON; we compare against paper-reported reference values with absolute tolerances. Recompute from raw DFT outputs is infeasible because no raw DFT artefacts are submitted.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference targets for band gaps and formation energies of BaReH9 and BaMnH9
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: BaReH9 band gap 3.58 eV (Fig. 2, direct at Γ), formation energy -99 kJ/mol H₂ (Section VI). BaMnH9 band gap ~3.0 eV (Section VI, Fig. 6), formation energy -86 kJ/mol H₂ (Section VI).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual LDA results reported in the paper; they are the correct reproduction targets.

outputs.description: Computed LDA direct band gap at Γ (eV) and formation energy (kJ/mol H₂) for BaReH9.
Computed LDA band gap at Γ (eV) and formation energy (kJ/mol H₂) for hypothetical BaMnH9.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare these values to hidden paper-reported reference values with absolute tolerances (±0.2 eV for band gaps, ±20 kJ/mol H₂ for formation energies).
